# Units: metal

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_3/structure.data

# Define potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# Compute temperature and pressure
compute myTemp all temp
compute myPress all pressure myTemp

# NPT ensemble with Nose-Hoover thermostat and barostat
# Heating from 300K to 2500K over 1000 ps (1,000,000 steps)
# Tdamp = 100*dt = 0.1 ps, Pdamp = 1000*dt = 1.0 ps
fix npt_heat all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermo output
thermo 10000
thermo_style custom step temp press density vol etotal ke pe

# Run NPT heating
